_note: Fixed questions for bench/run.py. 'calls': tool calls that must succeed; 'args': arguments that must match (others are free); 'result': fields the tool result must have (dotted paths) (e.g. the DVF data is for the right municipality and period, whether or not the model passed the default period); 'allow_error': the call may return an error (the expected behaviour is to report it). 'allowed': other tools the question may need (not counted as unneeded calls). 'answer': 'value_from' takes a value from the result of the last successful call of that tool, in this run, and requires it in the answer; 'contains' requires these strings; 'no_amount' forbids a euro amount. A question with no 'calls' can be answered without a tool (Strasbourg: the property_prices description says that Alsace is not covered).
